Rays moving from the bottom up through c0-4 will paint the columns, but when encountering objects, they should set to marker 4 and stop there—this was expected from the demo. In the demo outputs, for row 2, the target is at c1, so the ray begins filling right inward and then stops, without any filling on the left side. My previous algorithm incorrectly allows rays to continue after hitting an object, which isn't what I want.

I’m thinking about filling rows 1 to 6 in columns 0 to 4, with objects marked to ensure they stop at certain positions. Previously, my algorithm had issues with marking targets correctly. If an object's value isn’t the background color, it should be marked appropriately. I'll adjust the logic to stop and preserve the original objects, ensuring functionality. It seems I need to evaluate pairs and verify outputs using a patch before final submission. Let's do that now!
